title: Grants
subtitle: Per-user authorization — consent grants (Mint exchange) and broker grants (upstream credential brokering).
selectUser: Select a user to see their grants.
consentRevokeCopy: Revoke consent for {{client}} to access {{resource}}? This will block future Mint exchanges and revoke any matching live Mint issuances. Already-vended Broker tokens are not affected.
brokerRevokeCopy: Revoke {{user}}'s broker connection to {{provider}}? Future broker exchanges will fail with consent_required. Already-vended upstream tokens stay live until expiry — Authplane cannot invalidate them at the upstream.
viewConsentIssuances: View issuances for this (user, client, resource) tuple
